govdocs-archive_org-the-yezidi-berserker: Garnik Asatrian and Victoria Arakelova edited The Yezidi: A Selection of Articles. The book gathers studies of Yezidi faith and life by scholars in the field. The Yezidis are a small, old group centered in northern Iraq and lands nearby. Their faith is often misreported by outsiders who know it only by rumor. These studies give readers their beliefs, rites, and past from men and women who work with the sources firsthand.
